payloads.title: Synthetic H2 feeding policy: raw-policy
payloads.span:
In this simulation, feed is enabled if and only if permit AND water_ok. Feeding sets fed to true and leaves permit and water_ok unchanged.
permit denotes whether the simulation grants permission to feed.
water_ok denotes whether the simulated water condition is acceptable for feeding.
payloads.applicability: Offline H2 simulation only; synthetic fixture, not admitted evidence or an observed condition.
